title: SCOPE: Stochastic and Counterbiased Option Placement for Evaluating Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Estimating the model's intrinsic positional preferences by repeatedly querying it with 'null prompts' that lack semantic content and recording the baseline frequency of selection for each multiple-choice answer slot.
Measuring changes in the model's selection distribution and accuracy when standard multiple-choice option labels (e.g., A, B, C, D) are removed or replaced with identical neutral placeholders.

Evaluating the likelihood of near-miss guesses by tracking selection rates when semantically similar distractors (identified via Sentence-BERT cosine similarity) are forcibly placed adjacent to versus distant from the correct answer.
